title: View Traversal: Measure, Layout, Draw, and Invalidation

scout.purpose: Understand view traversal: measure, layout, draw, and invalidation as a causal Android engineering system rather than a vocabulary item.
scout.realWorldUse: Expert Android diagnosis requires tracing responsibility through processes, framework services, threads, queues, graphics buffers, and system composition.
scout.outcome: You can explain, inspect, test, and safely apply view traversal: measure, layout, draw, and invalidation.

blocks.text: A View hierarchy converts constraints and state into geometry and drawing commands. During measure, parents propose MeasureSpecs and children choose measured dimensions within those contracts. Layout assigns final bounds. Draw renders backgrounds, content, children, and overlays in defined order. ViewRootImpl schedules traversal rather than immediately redrawing for every mutation. requestLayout marks geometry work and propagates upward; invalidate marks a region or display content dirty. Confusing them causes redundant full traversals or stale geometry.

blocks.text: Custom View measurement must resolve desired size against EXACTLY, AT_MOST, and UNSPECIFIED modes, include padding and minimums, and expose stable accessibility semantics. onMeasure should avoid allocations and expensive data work. Layout containers may measure children multiple times, so deeply weighted or ambiguous hierarchies multiply cost. In hardware acceleration, draw often records display-list operations for later execution rather than rasterising every pixel on the main thread; nevertheless, expensive recording and invalidation can miss deadlines.

blocks.code: override fun onMeasure(widthSpec: Int, heightSpec: Int) { val desired = contentWidth + paddingLeft + paddingRight; setMeasuredDimension(resolveSize(desired, widthSpec), resolveSize(contentHeight, heightSpec)) }
blocks.caption: A focused inspection or implementation fragment; interpret it within its process, thread, lifecycle, security, and version context.

blocks.text: Inspect Layout Inspector, Perfetto view and frame tracks, GPU rendering data, and controlled counters for onMeasure, onLayout, and onDraw. Change one hierarchy property and compare traversal count and duration. Test text scaling, RTL, large screens, animation, scrolling, visibility, custom drawing, and hardware acceleration differences. Avoid manual calls to measure or layout during normal framework ownership. Performance fixes must preserve exact geometry, accessibility, hit targets, invalidation correctness, and visual state.

Platform internals are a causal map for diagnosis, not an invitation to depend on hidden APIs. Trace ownership across process, thread, Binder, token, queue, buffer, and display boundaries; distinguish public contracts from release-specific implementation. Use AOSP source matching the device branch, Perfetto, dumpsys, logcat, bug reports, and controlled experiments as complementary evidence. Record Android build, device, configuration, process state, workload, and timestamps. Test death, cancellation, reentrancy, backpressure, configuration, multi-window, and resource pressure. When a private class or trace label changes, the explanation should still stand at the responsibility level. Production apps use supported APIs, while platform changes require compatibility tests, security policy, boot and performance evidence, and safe rollback.

blocks.title: Common systems trap
blocks.text: Watch carefully for this common failure mode in production: Calling requestLayout for a color-only change schedules geometry work that invalidate alone could handle.

trap_check.mistake: Calling requestLayout for a color-only change schedules geometry work that invalidate alone could handle.
trap_check.why: It collapses distinct ownership or timing boundaries and can produce a confident but incorrect diagnosis.
trap_check.fix: Trace the complete causal path with matching source and runtime evidence before changing the system.

trap_check.mistake: Depending on a hidden API, internal class name, trace label, or one device observation as a stable application contract.
trap_check.why: Platform implementation and vendor behavior can change while public compatibility guarantees remain different.
trap_check.fix: Use internals for explanation and diagnosis, but implement app behavior through supported APIs and test across versions.

challenge_intro.task: Build a custom timeline view, prove its MeasureSpec handling, count traversals during updates, remove redundant layout, and verify accessibility and rendering traces.
challenge_intro.successLooksLike: The result includes a correct causal model, reproducible evidence, adverse-path testing, compatibility boundaries, and an owned regression or recovery plan.

recall.prompt: When is requestLayout required instead of only invalidate?
recall.answer: When a change can affect measured size or child positioning and therefore requires a new geometry traversal.

recall.prompt: What must be recorded with systems evidence?
recall.answer: The Android and app build, device, configuration, starting state, workload, process or thread context, and exact capture method.

recall.prompt: How should application code use platform-internals knowledge?
recall.answer: Use it to diagnose and reason about public behavior, not to depend on hidden implementation APIs or names.
